scope: Operational author-informed contract-to-input map. Local preparation and source consistency only; no Paper/browser writes or native admission by this map.

status_vocabulary.INPUT_SPECIMEN_PRESENT: Concrete editable HTML/SVG construction input exists at the exact keys; native application/review is not asserted.

status_vocabulary.CONTRACT_ONLY_OR_INCOMPLETE_VARIANT: Specified behavior has no complete matching editable composition in this input set.
status_vocabulary.RETAINED_UNQUALIFIED: Existing domain/source reference is intentionally retained; no new concrete F02 example or qualification claimed.

instructions: Parent binds actual returned IDs; never derive IDs from names or keys.
Read back final subtree/JSX, screenshots and measured geometry at the exact native checkpoint.

Prepared page IDs are source routing intent; readme may have moved. Bind actual native page membership from the final readback.
A screenshot, an HTML input, an annotation and executable integration are separate evidence classes.
